no_tls: TLS is off on this hub (public.tls_listen in hub.json). Turn it on to link hubs, or list the addresses that may link without TLS in mesh.plaintext.allow
incomplete: The link code is incomplete. Generate a new one on the other hub
no_address: The link code has no address for the other hub
own_code: This is this hub’s own link code. Use it on another hub
fingerprint_changed: Already linked with this hub_id, but the public key fingerprint is different. Unlink the old one, then link again
code_invalid: The link code is invalid, used or expired. Generate a new one on the other hub
no_credentials: The other hub didn’t return link credentials. Update the other hub
wrong_hub: Connected to hub {got}, not {want} from the link code
